item.title: Results from the Large Format workshop
item.description:
Results from the introductory Large Format workshop at Llumàtics.

4×5" black-and-white sheet film, developed in a tray. The image quality that large format delivers is hard to explain until you have it in your hands.

item.title: Large Format workshop — behind the scenes
item.description:
This is how Saturday’s workshop at Llumàtics went.

The large format camera, 4×5" sheets, the ground glass, the black cloth over the head. The full ritual of large format photography, compressed into a single morning.
